sum: The opening tutorial quest: pick your first Warframe, learn movement and combat, and escape Captain Vor in your Liset.

other: Available on first login

steps.t: Watch the opening cinematic and choose your starter Warframe: Excalibur, Mag or Volt.
steps.tip: Excalibur is melee-focused, Mag is a crowd-control caster, Volt is fast and deals Electricity damage.

steps.t: Use your first ability to fight off the Grineer soldiers around you.
Follow the tutorial prompts to learn jumping, sliding, wall dashing, bullet jumping and aim gliding.
Pick up one melee weapon (Skana or Bo), one sidearm (Lato or Kunai) and one primary (Braton or Paris) along the way.
steps.tip: You receive the primary you did not pick in your inventory afterwards.

steps.t: Deplete Captain Vor's shields when he confronts you.
Hack the console to free your ship and let Ordis power it up.
Survive until the timer runs out, then board your Liset to escape.

fast: The defense stage only requires you to survive until the timer ends; the ship itself does not need protecting.
Mag's crowd control or Volt's speed make the tutorial fights trivial; Excalibur is the easiest all-rounder.
The opening cinematic can be rewatched later from the Codex, so you can skip it without missing anything.

sum: The follow-up to Awakening that walks you through Earth missions to rebuild your Orbiter's Communications and Foundry and break free of Captain Vor's Ascaris device.

steps.t: Start the quest right after Awakening and restore your Arsenal in the Orbiter.
Run the Spy mission on E Prime, Earth to recover the Communications segment.
steps.tip: Installing it unlocks the Market and matchmaking.

steps.t: Rescue Darvo on Mariana, Earth.
steps.tip: He gives you the Ascaris Negator blueprint.

steps.t: Grab the Foundry segment on Mantle, Earth, then clear the Grineer.
Destroy the three Corpus supply caches on Gaia, Earth to get the Negator materials.
steps.tip: The caches are guaranteed to drop what you need.

steps.t: Build the Ascaris Negator in the Foundry.
Recover the navigation segment from the Galleon on Pacific, Earth.
steps.tip: Destroying the reactor afterwards is optional.

steps.t: Assassinate Captain Vor on Cambria, Earth to finish the quest.

fast: On Pacific, the reactor sabotage is optional; extract right after grabbing the navigation segment to save time.
The Ascaris Negator builds in about 10 seconds with no rush cost, so there is no waiting.
On Mariana a rare extraction tile always spawns with a hidden Kuria; bring Codex Scanners if you want to grab it.
First-time mission rewards are fixed, so just play straight through; replaying earlier steps gives nothing extra.

sum: A short quest where Teshin teaches you how mods, elements and fusion work; it also unlocks Cetus and Nightwave.

other: Cannot be started while the Backroom is set as your base of operations

steps.t: Start The Teacher from the Codex in your Orbiter.
Fight through the Corpus in the Earth forest and reach the Mod Segment.
Duel Teshin with the Thornbak until two of his three health bars are gone.
Equip Stormbringer on the Thornbak in the Arsenal to break the Electricity-weak target drones.
steps.tip: Match the mod's polarity to lower its cost.

steps.t: Add Cryo Rounds to combine Cold and Electricity into Magnetic for the next drones.
Equip Vitality on your Warframe, fight off the Corpus and escape with the Mod Segment within the time limit.
Install the Mod Segment, dissolve the spare Stormbringers into Endo and use it to rank up your equipped Stormbringer.
Board the Corpus ship, rescue and then capture Teshin, and sabotage the reactor to finish.

fast: Follow each Arsenal prompt exactly (equip, dissolve, fuse); the quest will not advance until each one is done.
If you already have Vitality equipped, swap to the unranked copy Teshin gives you so the step registers.
On the final ship, hack the two adjacent terminals and shoot the reactor core straight away to finish the sabotage fast.
rw: Pressure Point, Fury, Serration, Hornet Strike, Heated Charge, Continuity, Equilibrium, Redirection

sum: A solo quest in Fortuna and the Orb Vallis that unlocks the Solaris United syndicate, Fortuna bounties and the K-Drive Launcher.

other: Complete the Junction leading to Venus so you can reach Fortuna
Talk with Eudico in Fortuna

steps.t: Go to Fortuna on Venus and talk to Eudico, then Thursby.
Loot the three Corpus supply caches in the Orb Vallis.
steps.tip: Look for barrel-like containers with smoke rising from them.

steps.t: Shoot down the Corpus spy drone and kill the 20 reinforcements, then return to Fortuna.
Talk to Thursby and The Business, then hack the bunker terminal to steal the hit list.
Investigate the four bodies, then hack the terminal and defend it to free the captured field squad.
steps.tip: Killing Terra Jailers drops a data key that speeds up the hack.

steps.t: Talk to Eudico, defend the excavator to dig up Amarast, and head for the coolant tower.
Talk to Eudico again, detonate the K-bomb outside Fortuna and fight off the Corpus waves.
Talk to Eudico, take the K-Drive past the Profit-Taker Orb, hack and defend the coolant tower, then deliver the Amarast.
Return to Fortuna to finish the quest.

fast: Kill the Terra Jailers during the hostage hack; their data keys make the defense much shorter.
Use the K-Drive and your Archwing (if you have it) to cross the Orb Vallis quickly between objectives.
Bring a Warframe with area damage or crowd control for the excavator and coolant tower defenses.

sum: A short three-mission quest on Mercury that introduces the Infested and rewards Molten Impact and the Heat Sword blueprint.

other: Complete the Mercury Junction

steps.t: Start Once Awake from the Codex in your Orbiter.
Run the Spy mission on M Prime, Mercury and recover the data.
steps.tip: You only need to reach extraction with at least one data unit.

steps.t: Exterminate the Infested on the Galleon at Terminus, Mercury.
Defend the Cascade Bomb on the power core in the Defense mission on Lares, Mercury.

fast: On M Prime you can extract once you have a single data unit; you do not need all three.
Heat damage works well against the Infested; equip the Molten Impact mod you get after Terminus.
Bring a crowd-control Warframe such as Mag for the Lares defense.

sum: A solo quest on Deimos where you help the Entrati family repair the Heart; it unlocks the Entrati syndicate, Necralisk bounties and the Xaku blueprint.

other: Complete the Earth to Mars Junction

steps.t: Start Heart of Deimos from the Codex and go to the Cambion Drift.
Destroy the two Infested Hives (clear the Infested each one spawns) to enter the Necralisk.
Ask Mother all three questions.
Find Father in the Cambion Drift, then talk to Daughter in the Necralisk.
Collect 10 Fass Residue and catch 3 fish for Daughter.
steps.tip: A Fishing Spear is provided at the site if you do not own one.

steps.t: Clear the Infested outside the Necralisk and talk to Daughter.
Take the Esophage down to the Heart and solve the Requiem Cipher door.
steps.tip: Hit the Reactive Crystals in the order of the symbols, top to bottom; retries are unlimited.

steps.t: Sneak back to the surface past the Necramechs with your disabled Warframe.
Pilot the Voidrig, destroy the three Infested Hives, patch the Heart and defeat the rogue Necramech.
steps.tip: Aim for its shoulder joints, face plate and the blue Void scar on its back.

steps.t: Talk to Grandmother in the Necralisk to finish.

fast: You cannot fail the Voidrig stage because you respawn on death, so play aggressively.
Shoot the rogue Necramech's shoulder joints first to remove its guns and melee.
Fass Residue acts as bait, so fish right where it lands rather than wandering.
After destroying the first two hives the open world is quiet, so break containers for free starter resources.

sum: Build your first Archwing, the Odonata, and fly it in space; this unlocks Archwing missions, the Archwing Launcher and Empyrean.

other: Complete the Mars Junction

steps.t: Start The Archwing from the Codex to receive the Odonata blueprint.
Run the Orokin Sabotage on Tessera, Venus to recover the archive.
steps.tip: Reverse the portal, defend the generator, then grab the marked cache in the Void.

steps.t: Run the Excavations on Aphrodite (Venus), Mantle (Earth) and E Gate (Venus) for the Wings, Harness and Systems blueprints.
steps.tip: You can extract after the first excavator finishes on each.

steps.t: Build the three Odonata parts and the Odonata in the Foundry.
Run the Exterminate on Montes, Venus.
Equip your Archwing, destroy the Zeplen nets and fly to extraction away from the Balor Fomorian.

fast: Extract after the first successful excavation on each node; one completion gives the blueprint.
The Odonata parts and the Odonata itself now take about a minute each to build, so farm the resources first and build right away.
On Tessera you can ignore the optional Orokin caches; only the marked one in the Void is needed.

sum: A five-mission quest investigating strange drones that reveals the Lotus's secret and rewards an Exilus Warframe Adapter.

steps.t: Start Natah from the Codex in your Orbiter.
Scan the mysterious drones and the wreckage on Gaia, Earth.
steps.tip: Bring Codex Scanners; you must scan the marked targets or the mission fails.

steps.t: Hack the three Grineer consoles in the Mobile Defense on Cassini, Saturn.
Capture Sergeant Scur on Sycorax, Uranus.
Survive for 10 minutes on Ariel, Uranus.
Defend the bomb for 5 waves on Desdemona, Uranus.
steps.tip: The objective you must protect switches between waves.

fast: Buy Codex Scanners from the Market before starting; if your Oculyst Codex entry is already complete, use a Synthesis Scanner instead.
Bring a survival-friendly Warframe for Ariel's 10 minutes and a fast one for Desdemona, where the defended objective moves each wave.
Sycorax is a straightforward Capture: head to the marked target, down Sergeant Scur and capture him.
was: Older guides, and the info box on the wiki, say Natah needs the Uranus Junction or scanning Oculyst drones on Uranus. That was removed: Natah now starts automatically once you finish The Archwing.

sum: A major story quest that reveals the Operator and unlocks Focus, Lua and the Broken War.

other: Complete the Neptune Junction
An Archwing (from The Archwing quest) for the two Uranus missions

steps.t: Start The Second Dream from the Codex (optionally watch its cinematic first).
Hack both data vaults in the Spy mission on Umbriel, Uranus.
steps.tip: Archwing required.

steps.t: Find the Sentient fragment underwater on Cressida, Uranus.
steps.tip: If you take about five minutes, a waypoint is added for you.

steps.t: Follow the Stalker on Neso, Neptune: beat the Sentient, use the Void Key, then destroy the four vials to disable the tower.
On Plato, Lua, hack the console, reactivate the three void compasses and destroy the four Pendula.
Play Grimaldi, Lua solo and carry the person to extraction.
Fill the Somatic Link three times in your Orbiter while the Stalker attacks.
steps.tip: You do not need to defeat the Stalker.

steps.t: Customize your Operator and choose a Focus school to finish.

fast: In the final Orbiter fight, fire the Operator beam in short bursts to destroy the Stalker's energy waves; just fill the Somatic Link, the Stalker cannot be killed.
On Cressida, Alad V gives hints when you are near the fragment, and marks it for you after about five minutes.
Your Focus school choice is permanent as your first school; the dialogue answers only reorder the options.
A tanky Warframe with a defensive ability like Iron Skin helps on Grimaldi, where you cannot use weapons.

sum: A major story quest where you chase Teshin to the Kuva Fortress and gain full Operator Transference; it unlocks Sorties, Kuva missions, The Quills and Vox Solaris.

other: Complete the Pluto Junction on Neptune

steps.t: Start The War Within from the Codex after the Lotus's inbox message.
Chase and capture Teshin's Specter on Zeipel, Lua.
Capture another Teshin Specter on Carpo, Jupiter.
Solo the Archwing mission on Naga, Sedna: disable the security matrix, dodge the scanners and defend the console for 2 minutes.
steps.tip: Once you continue into the Fortress you cannot change gear or leave.

steps.t: Infiltrate Dakata, Kuva Fortress and insert the three Elevator Keys to reach the Queens.
As the Operator, escape the Orbiter and climb the Mountain Pass on Earth.
Cross the Golden Maw bone chambers, unlocking Void Sling, Void Mode and Transference.
steps.tip: Keep moving between safe platforms.

steps.t: Defeat the Kuva Guardians and destroy the nine red braids in the Queens' chamber.
steps.tip: Void Sling through a Guardian to make it vulnerable.

steps.t: Defeat Teshin with your Warframe's melee, then Void Sling the Queen when she lowers her shield.
Return to the Mountain Pass, clear the obstacles with Void Sling and Void Beam, and meet Teshin at the summit.

fast: Bring a strong melee weapon; only melee works for the Warframe in the Queens' chamber.
Void Sling through each Kuva Guardian to knock away its Kesheg, then finish it once it switches to pistols.
In the Fortress you can simply sprint past the scanners instead of sneaking.
Operator deaths add stacking Transference Static, so swap back to your Warframe before your Operator dies.
rw: Access to The Quills, Vox Solaris and Necraloid

sum: Recover and repair six Railjack parts with Cephalon Cy to build your own Railjack.

other: Access to a Dry Dock in your Clan Dojo or a Saturn or Pluto Relay

steps.t: Start Rising Tide from the Codex and build the Railjack Cephalon blueprint.
steps.tip: Needs 5,000 Credits, 15 Mutagen Samples, 15 Detonite Ampules and 15 Fieldron Samples.

steps.t: Install Cephalon Cy at a Dry Dock.
Recover the Fuselage on Ares, Mars by defending the wreck while Cy scans it.
steps.tip: Kill the Interference Drones; the scan stalls while they are alive.

steps.t: Deposit the repair resources at the Dry Dock after each part.
steps.tip: Each repair takes about one to two minutes and cannot be rushed.

steps.t: Recover the Propulsion System on Cervantes, Earth.
Recover the Port Nacelle on Plato, Lua.
Recover the Starboard Nacelle on Tessera, Venus.
Recover the Tail Section on Berehynia, Sedna.
Recover the Engine Cowling on Orias, Europa.
Confirm Cephalon Cy's integration at the Dry Dock to finish.

fast: Farm repair resources first: Plastids, Rubedo, Neural Sensors, Cryotic, an Orokin Cell, Nano Spores, Circuits, Alloy Plate, Polymer Bundle, Ferrite, Detonite Ampules and Salvage.
Kill Interference Drones the moment they appear; scan progress freezes while they live.
Stay inside the defense circle, and bring a crowd-control Warframe for the Sentient waves in later missions.
A fully built Railjack can be bought from the Market for 175 Platinum, which skips the quest entirely.

sum: A horror-themed quest with the Red Veil where you track down Rell's manifestations; it rewards the Harrow blueprint and Iron Wake access.

other: Visit Onkko in Cetus and get the Mote Amp

steps.t: Visit Onkko in Cetus as your Operator and get the Mote Amp, then start the quest from the Codex.
Investigate the derelict Galleon on Pacific, Earth and defend Palladino until the timer runs out.
Meet Palladino at Iron Wake, Earth.
steps.tip: Use Transference to enter the guest quarters.

steps.t: Retrieve Rell's relic from the Corpus ship on Hydra, Pluto and escape.
Return to Iron Wake and finish the emotion card game.
Trap and kill three of Rell's emotions on Exequias, Deimos with Kinetic Siphon Traps.
steps.tip: Rell's main manifestation cannot be killed, so avoid it.

steps.t: Repeat on Stephano, Uranus.
Repeat on Everest, Earth.
In the Tiwaz temple, kill the Red Veil Fanatics and break the glowing chains with your Operator's Void Beam.

fast: Buy plenty of Kinetic Siphon Traps from Cephalon Simaris and equip them in your Gear before the three capture missions.
Unlock The Quills and Vox Solaris and build an Amp before the last mission; the Mote Amp alone boosts your Operator.
Keep moving as the Operator in the final fight and use Void Sling to knock down Fanatics who block.
Deploy a Specter or two with area-damage weapons to clear the Fanatics quickly.

sum: A short story quest started from your Personal Quarters that sends you to Lua and the Void and sets up The Sacrifice.

other: Own the Personal Quarters segment

steps.t: Touch the violet Lua orb at the end of your Orbiter's Personal Quarters.
steps.tip: You cannot be in a squad.

steps.t: On Lua, touch the orb and follow the purple trail to the broken Reservoir.
Jump down the pit and continue as your Operator.
Walk to the pod at the end of the hall to trigger the final cutscene.

fast: There is no combat; just follow the trail and listen to the dialogue.
Make sure you are solo before touching the orb, or it will not start.

sum: A story quest where you track a mysterious Warframe across the system; it rewards Excalibur Umbra, the Skiajati and Umbra mods.

steps.t: Start The Sacrifice from the Codex and examine the Lotus's helmet in your Personal Quarters.
On Lith, Earth, open the vine door and scan the Skiajati, shawl, helmet and remains in the courtyard.
steps.tip: Codex or Synthesis Scanners work.

steps.t: Solve the two Orokin memory ciphers on Pavlov, Lua and bring back the Vitruvian.
steps.tip: Match the order of the symbol pairs you find nearby.

steps.t: Build Excalibur Umbra in the Foundry and try to equip it.
steps.tip: Needs 10,000 Credits, 1 Orokin Cell, 60 Kuva, 1,200 Nano Spores and 1,600 Alloy Plate; it builds in seconds.

steps.t: Track Umbra on Nuovo, Ceres and use Transference on him.
Pursue Umbra on Triton, Neptune and repeat.
Confront Umbra on Tycho, Lua as your Operator.
steps.tip: Break his shields with Void Beam, stun with Void Sling, then Transference.

steps.t: Return to Lith, Earth and fight the Sentients and Ballas to finish.

fast: Each Umbra fight follows the same pattern: Void Beam his shields, Void Sling to stun, then Transference into him.
Have an Orokin Cell, Nano Spores and Alloy Plate ready so you can build Umbra immediately (the 60 Kuva drops on Pavlov).
If you want the Somachord song, scan the fragment in every mission in order; missing one means replaying the quest.
If you wait too long on the second Lua cipher, Ordis solves it for you.

sum: A story arc of three short mini-quests (Chimera Prologue, Erra and The Maker) that leads into The New War and rewards the Paracesis and Shedu blueprints.

other: Play Chimera Prologue, then Erra, then The Maker from the Codex

steps.t: After The Sacrifice, start Chimera Prologue from the Codex and touch the Lotus's helmet in your Personal Quarters.
Follow The Man in the Wall through the Lua Reservoir and beat the shadow fights.
In the Sentient chamber, Void Sling between hiding spots so Ballas does not see you, then grab the sword.
steps.tip: If his sight bar empties, you fail.

steps.t: Start Erra from the Codex and touch the Lotus's helmet again to watch the vision.
Start The Maker to watch the final cutscene.

fast: Erra and The Maker are mostly cutscenes, so all three parts take only a few minutes each.
In the Chimera Prologue stealth section, move only when Ballas is looking away and wait at each Void Sling point.
Finishing Chimera Prologue also unlocks The Ropalolyst on Jupiter, which drops the Wisp Warframe.

sum: A short main quest and the first act of the Prelude to War. It gives you the Paracesis blueprint and unlocks the Ropalolyst boss, which drops Wisp.

steps.t: Start the quest from the Codex (Prelude to War chapters) after finishing The Sacrifice.
steps.tip: Starting it from the Codex clears your other active quests so the interaction triggers.

steps.t: Go to your Orbiter's Personal Quarters and touch the Lotus's helmet on its plinth.
On Lua, follow the figure wearing the helmet through the Reservoir.
steps.tip: Three times you'll be trapped in a barrier and have to kill shadowy copies of the Lotus.

steps.t: Go through the Chamber of the Lotus and enter the portal at the end.
In the Sentient chamber, press fire to Void Sling to each glowing spot.
Stay hidden from Ballas's gaze by dashing between Void Dash points until the sword forms, then grab it.
steps.tip: If the meter at the top empties, the mission fails.

steps.t: Wake up on the Orbiter with the Paracesis blueprint.

fast: Any Warframe works; the only fighting is a few waves of shadow Lotus enemies on Lua, so bring something with good area damage to clear the barrier fights fast.
During the Ballas stealth part, keep moving between cover points and don't linger in his line of sight.
Run the Ropalolyst assassination on Jupiter right after if you want Wisp.

sum: A short, mostly cinematic main quest and the second act of the Prelude to War. It sets up The New War and rewards the Shedu blueprint.

steps.t: Start Erra from the Codex under the Prelude to War chapters.
Go to your Orbiter's Personal Quarters.
Touch the Lotus's headgear (it glows purple).
Watch the flashback and vision cutscenes to the end.
Collect the Shedu blueprint once you're back on the Orbiter.

fast: There is no combat to prepare for; it's almost entirely cutscenes, so just start it from the Codex and watch.
Do it right after Chimera Prologue, then play The Maker straight away to finish the Prelude to War.

sum: The third and final act of the Prelude to War: a single cutscene. Watching it finishes the Prelude to War so you can move on to The New War.

steps.t: Open the Codex and find The Maker under the Prelude to War quests.
Select it to play the cutscene.
steps.tip: It has no diorama or Begin button; selecting it plays the cutscene straight away.

steps.t: Watch to the end; the Prelude to War is now complete.

fast: It's only a cutscene, so there is nothing to bring or prepare.
Use the time to get ready for The New War: own a Railjack and an Amp before you start it.

sum: A long cinematic main quest where the Sentient invasion comes to a head. It unlocks the Drifter, the Sirocco amp and Narmer bounties, and is required for many later quests.

other: Own a Railjack
Own an Amp

steps.t: Prepare your arsenal, then start the quest from the Codex and type NEWWAR to confirm.
steps.tip: Loadout access is limited and normal activities are locked until you finish, but progress is saved between missions.

steps.t: Play the opening chapter as Kahl, Veso and Teshin, including a Railjack battle in the Veil Proxima.
steps.tip: Kahl's part uses stealth around Sentient search parties; Veso orders a Breacher MOA to solve puzzles.

steps.t: As the Drifter, sneak through Fortuna and the Spaceport while avoiding Narmer Deacons.
steps.tip: Deacons that spot you can blow the Narmer veil.

steps.t: Take the Nataruk bow and escape back to the surface.
Hunt down and defeat the three Archons.
steps.tip: The first two must be fought with the Drifter and Nataruk only; the final one lets you use your Warframe.

steps.t: Choose whether the Drifter or the Operator faces Ballas (cosmetic only).
On your Orbiter, gear up and head to Cetus with the Paracesis equipped.
steps.tip: If you never built a Paracesis, you get a temporary unranked one.

steps.t: Free Konzu and rescue Fisher Hai-Luk, Master Teasonai and Hok, then climb Unum's Tower using Void damage on the crystals.
steps.tip: At the top you have 60 seconds to activate two crystals.

steps.t: Fight through the Murex, then fly your Railjack to Praghasa, using wreckage as cover from the heat waves.
Push through Praghasa in a Necramech, then beat the final boss by luring beams onto the Narmer lenses.
steps.tip: If you don't own a Necramech, you're given a Bonewidow.

steps.t: Choose the Lotus's name at the end; it is permanent.

fast: Build and mod a Paracesis before starting; otherwise you're stuck with an unranked, unmoddable one for the Cetus and Praghasa parts.
Have a decently equipped Railjack: the wiki says Sigma MK I components and an Engineer crew member are enough.
Owning a modded Necramech helps on Praghasa; without one you get a loaner Bonewidow.
Saving the 10 optional Ostrons in Cetus takes extra time and can be skipped.
If the button-mashing escapes are hard, switch them to hold in Settings > Accessibility > Repeated Button Presses.

sum: A solo main quest that follows the Drifter through the kingdom of Duviri. It unlocks The Duviri Experience, The Lone Story and The Circuit, plus a Kaithe and the Sun & Moon blueprint.

other: Complete the Uranus Junction

steps.t: Start the quest and follow the Drifter's escape through Duviri.
steps.tip: Use Guiding Hand to find the way, Restorative to heal and Smoke Screen to go invisible.

steps.t: Summon a Kaithe, reach Teshin's cave and unlock Summon Kaithe with your Intrinsics.
Learn melee basics in the ambush, then pick a Warframe (Excalibur, Mag or Volt) and weapons.
Clear the two Exterminate waves in the Undercroft and find the book.
Prince of Fire: finish the anger-day objectives (Dax patrols, guarded chest, Exterminate) and return the figurine piece.
Harbinger of Joy: finish the joy-day objectives (maze, Liminus, chest hacking, 5-minute Survival).
Covetous Courtier: finish the envy-day objectives (power lines, high-ground Dax, 3-wave Defense).
Escape the Undercroft and defeat the impostor.
Fight your way to Thrax's stronghold, take control of the Orowyrm and recover the last figurine piece.

fast: Pick Volt or Excalibur for the Warframe segments; Volt's speed and Excalibur's melee clear the Exterminate and Survival stages fast, while Mag offers crowd control for Defense.
Use Smoke Screen to skip fights you don't need while traveling between objectives.
Ride the Kaithe between objective markers instead of running.
Afterwards, The Lone Story is the quickest way to replay the Spiral's story with no side content.

sum: A solo main quest set beneath Deimos in Albrecht Entrati's laboratories. It gives Qorvex, a pre-ranked Grimoire, melee Exilus and Arcane slots, and opens the Cavia syndicate.

steps.t: Read Loid's inbox message and meet him in the Necralisk.
Follow Loid down into Albrecht's Laboratories and fight off the hostile Necramechs.
Pick up the Grimoire, defeat the Murmur and wake the Sleeper.
Hack the old computer in the Sanctum Anatomica to link with the Vessel.
steps.tip: Match the scrolling symbols while avoiding the red dots.

steps.t: Equip the fully ranked Grimoire in your Arsenal.
Survive the two-wave Mirror Defense, collecting glyphs to reinforce the objective.
Take Tagfer's Keyglyph to the Netracell, hack the three marked terminals, clear the security wave and grab the Pom-2 Board.
Build Albrecht's Blueprint in the Foundry and activate the Jahu Gargoyle.
steps.tip: It needs 1 Shrill Voca and takes 99 seconds.

steps.t: Find the missing page in an Exterminate mission.
Return to the Sanctum and defeat The Fragmented Suzerain, using the Grimoire linked to the Gargoyle.

fast: Bring a Warframe with strong area damage or crowd control for the Mirror Defense and the Netracell security phase.
Use the free Grimoire: it is rank 30 with a Catalyst and infinite ammo, and its Void attacks are what hurt the Murmur in the final fight.
Start building Albrecht's Blueprint the moment you get it; the build only takes 99 seconds.
Exterminate stages end as soon as the kill count is met, so bring a fast mover.

sum: A short, solo main quest that bridges Whispers in the Walls and The Hex. The Drifter answers a strange call and gets a first glimpse of 1999.

steps.t: Go to the Sanctum Anatomica.
Walk to the Void expanse behind the defeated Vessel, where the Lotus waits.
Answer the ringing KinePage as the Drifter.
Follow Kalymos the Kavat through the abandoned mall to the next ringing pager.
Return to the present to finish, then read Loid's inbox message.

fast: No combat gear matters; it's a short story walk with quick-time prompts.
Play it soon after Whispers in the Walls, since it's needed for both The Hex and The Old Peace.

sum: A solo main quest where the Drifter goes to 1999 Höllvania and teams up with the Protoframes of The Hex. It unlocks Höllvania missions, The Hex syndicate, the Atomicycle and Cyte-09.

steps.t: Start the quest from the Codex and type KALYMOS to confirm.
steps.tip: Only the Drifter's Amps and gear are used; normal activities are locked until you finish.

steps.t: Play as Arthur through Höllvania and destroy the H-04 Efervon Tank.
steps.tip: Shoot the 8 vents, then grab a Thermian RPG from Scaldra troops to finish it.

steps.t: Take your loaner Excalibur and Atomicycle and run the Exterminate against Scaldra.
Survive the 10-minute Hell-Scrub with Quincy.
Chase the convoy and blow up the escorts with the Thermian RPG.
Choose which Hex member takes point and fight the waves, then clear the Rotpods and defeat the Legacyte as Eleanor.
Make your way through the Zariman section.
Hold out in the New Year's Eve finale defense as each Hex member in turn.

fast: You can't bring your own gear, so practise the loaner Excalibur's kit early; Exalted Blade clears most stages quickly.
In Hell-Scrub, kill Techrot Babau fast so they don't drain life support.
Summon the Atomicycle to travel; Atomi-Barrage and Atomi-Bomb also deal heavy damage.
The Finale needs 'Liked' Chemistry with all six Hex members on KIM, which you can only raise once a day, so start chatting and doing their bounties right away.

sum: A main quest where the Operator dives into forgotten memories of the Tau system. It rewards the Uriel blueprint and unlocks the Dark Refractory modes and La Cathédrale.

other: Do not have the Backroom set as your Base of Operations

steps.t: Start the quest and go to the Sanctum Anatomica.
As Excalibur Prime, lure the Hunhullus into the crater and break its knee joints to damage it.
steps.tip: Destroy Marrowticks to make grapple points that also add Void damage.

steps.t: Explore Tauron Academy, then fight alongside the Grineer against the Dax and defeat the Dactolyst.
Capture the three Anarch Liberators with the Vinquibus, scrambling the Targeting Node with Authorization Codes.
Escort the Palanquin through Perintol Crater.
Attend the ceremony at Tokh-Amn, then go to World-Seeder.
Defeat the Commandeered Protea Prime and Commandeered Caliban Prime in Zariman Five-Nine.
steps.tip: You may get a 90-second Somatic Bearer buff from another player; leave your own after.

steps.t: Defeat the Hunhullus for good, breaking the chest joint for the last health bar.
Take control of Uriel and storm Tauron Academy.

fast: The quest gives you your loadouts for the memory sections, so the main preparation is knowing the boss mechanics: hit the Hunhullus's Synovia joints, not its body.
Use the Marrowtick grapple points in the Hunhullus fights for mobility and bonus Void damage.
Dying sends you back to the last checkpoint with no revive, so play the boss fights carefully rather than rushing.
Switch your Base of Operations away from the Backroom before you start, or the quest won't begin.

sum: A solo main quest played as the Stalker as he tries to save Jade. It rewards the Jade blueprint and unlocks the Ascension mode on Uranus.

steps.t: Start from the Codex and type SHADOWS to confirm.
steps.tip: It contains scenes of trauma related to motherhood.

steps.t: As Stalker, follow the jade feathers through his lair on Uranus.
Raid the Corpus ship on Phobos for Bioplasma in a 4-vault Spy mission.
steps.tip: Stalker always breaches consoles and his Smoke Screen gets you through lasers.

steps.t: Destroy the Corpus proxies that ambush you.
Sneak into the Tenno's Orbiter past Ordis and reach the Transference room.
Defeat the Juggernaut Behemoth on Eris for Cortichrome.
Time your jumps to the chorus to give the medicine.
steps.tip: The quest continues even if you miss.

steps.t: Escape the Corpus assault carrying the child, then name him.

fast: Stalker's kit is preset and powerful (Dread, Despair, Hate, and a passive bonus against enemies that can't see him), so nothing needs preparing.
In the Spy mission, use Smoke Screen to walk through laser barriers instead of solving the vaults.
On the Orbiter, wait for Ordis to open the Transference room door and slip in behind him.

sum: A solo main quest that continues Stalker's story as he deals with his sons from the future. It rewards the Sirius & Orion blueprint and unlocks Uranus Proxima missions.

steps.t: Start from the Codex and type FATHER to confirm.
Head to the Orb Vallis and defeat the dual boss Emerald X Crimson.
steps.tip: You play Stalker with infinite revives.

steps.t: Return to the lair and talk to Hunhow.
Sneak onto the Tenno's Orbiter, use the Helminth to distract Ordis, and reach Excalibur Umbra.
Win a one-round Interception on Venus with Umbra.
Choose who to hunt first, then take down both mentors: Vena (Spy) and Ryoku (Capture).
steps.tip: The choice only sets the order; you fight both.

steps.t: Go to Uranus Proxima, collect the Void Spark and defeat the phantom.
Deliver the Void Spark to Hunhow back at the lair to finish.

fast: Stalker's preset kit plus infinite revives makes the boss fights forgiving; focus on dodging the charges.
In The Kuva Wytch Spy mission, stealth isn't needed because there are no alarms or cameras, so just run to the terminals.
After the first hunt, switch to Umbra's weapons if you prefer them for the second mentor.

sum: A solo main quest aboard the Zariman Ten Zero. It unlocks the Zariman missions, the Holdfasts syndicate, Incarnon weapons from Cavalero and Gyre bounties.

steps.t: Upgrade your Operator/Drifter and spend unused Focus, then start the quest.
steps.tip: Swap a Mote Amp for a stronger one such as Sirocco.

steps.t: Head to the Zariman and find the source of the song.
Stop the Void Cascade by closing the rifts on each Exolizer with Void damage.
steps.tip: Then kill the Void Manifestation and the Thrax Centurion.

steps.t: Talk to Quinn.
Stop the Void Flood: bring Vitoplast to the Void Ruptures to seal them.
steps.tip: Each sealed rupture lowers the gauge by 30%.

steps.t: Get the defense briefing from Cavalero.
Protect the Reliquary Drive: collect Argozene and build turrets to guard the Exodampers.
Defeat the Void Angel: knock down its first bar, jump into the bubble as Operator and destroy its ethereal form.
steps.tip: Falling out of bounds or dying in the bubble boots you out.

steps.t: Retrieve Quinn's tablet to finish.

fast: Bring a strong Amp like Sirocco and a ranked Operator or Drifter; the Void Cascade and Void Angel stages rely on Void damage.
Use a fast Warframe for Void Flood so you can collect Vitoplast and reach ruptures quickly.
In the Reliquary Drive defense, build a turret early to start the enemy wave and earn more Argozene from kills.

sum: A solo side quest on the Plains of Eidolon to help Saya find out what happened to her husband. It rewards the Gara blueprint.

other: Complete at least 1 Plains of Eidolon bounty from Konzu

steps.t: Talk to Konzu in Cetus, finish one bounty, then return to him to start.
Talk to Saya in Cetus and agree to help.
Go to the Grineer drilling site on the Plains, clear the area and destroy the drill's augers.
Pick up the Ostron Coffer in the cave.
On the Orbiter, examine the coffer in the Codex and equip Codex Scanners in your Gear.
steps.tip: You can't continue without scanners equipped.

steps.t: Scan the Shatter-lock key shards at the Grineer camp and kill the reinforcements.
Board Hek's Galleon, defeat the Nox ambush and reach the shard vault.
Back on the Plains at night, find the round rock on the mound, remove it and scan the last shard, then extract.

fast: Bring Helios with Investigator; it scans the glass shards automatically when you're in range.
Synthesis Scanners also work for the shards if you have them.
Avoid the Eidolon fight in the final stage; use the side cave and go straight to extraction.
Don't destroy the Tusk Bolkor during the reinforcements phase; the wiki lists this as a quest-breaking bug.
rw: Shrine Defense access (Koumei, with Once Awake)

sum: A short solo side quest that gets you the Incubator Segment and your first Kubrow (or other incubated pet).

other: Complete the Venus to Mercury Junction

steps.t: Start the quest from the Codex.
Survive 5 minutes on Unda, Venus to get the Incubator Segment.
Install the Incubator Segment in your Orbiter.
Find a Kubrow Egg by destroying Kubrow Dens on E Prime, Earth.
steps.tip: Dens drop an egg 100% of the time during the quest; skip this step if you already own an egg.

steps.t: Get an Incubator Power Core and incubate the egg.
steps.tip: Incubation takes 1 minute during the quest.

steps.t: Defend your new pet for 3 waves on Gaia, Earth.
steps.tip: It can be revived if it goes down.

fast: Claim the Incubator Power Core from the Venus to Mercury Junction task (after Vox Solaris) instead of crafting it.
Already own an egg (e.g. from the Market) to skip the Earth egg hunt.
In the final Defense, bring crowd control or area damage so enemies don't focus the fragile pet.

sum: A side quest where you hunt the thief Maroo and recover the Arcane Codices. It rewards the Ether Daggers and an Orokin Catalyst blueprint, and unlocks Maroo's weekly Ayatan hunt.

other: Complete the Phobos Junction

steps.t: Capture Maroo on Tharsis, Mars.
steps.tip: She turns invisible and fights back when downed, so be careful finishing the capture.

steps.t: Steal the Arcane Codex data in a Spy mission on Unda, Venus.
Do the Spy mission on a Grineer Galleon on Pantheon, Mercury.
Do the Spy mission on a Corpus ship on Roche, Phobos.
Fight through the Infested on Alator, Mars, take the portal to the Derelict and find the Arcane Machine.
Defeat the Arcane Boiler and Infested, then extract.

fast: Bring Loki or Ash for the three Spy missions; invisibility makes the vaults much easier.
Each Spy mission has three Data Vaults; avoid alarms so the data isn't destroyed.
Don't sell the Ether Daggers: replaying the quest won't give the blueprint again.

sum: A solo side quest where you play as the Grineer Lancer Kahl-175 freeing his brothers from a Murex. Finishing it unlocks Archon Hunts, Kahl's Garrison and weekly Break Narmer missions.

steps.t: Start Veilbreaker from the Codex and read Daughter's inbox message.
Board the Murex and disable the Medusa Hub by shooting its 9 floating energy nodes in sequence.
steps.tip: You have under a minute; shoot them in order quickly.

steps.t: As Kahl, pick up a Grakata and free the trapped Grineer by standing in the dissipation field to fill the gauge.
steps.tip: The field moves around; Kahl's health regenerates and the Grakata has infinite reserve ammo.

steps.t: Use Command Mode (waypoint key, G by default) to order your brothers to blow up debris, focus targets or hold fields.
steps.tip: Point at debris to plant a charge; point at a field to have a brother hold it while you stand in another.

steps.t: Grab the Hellion jetpack and free the next captives by holding separate dissipation fields with your units.
Ride the Bolkor gunship, then continue on foot after it crashes and head to the hangar for evac.
Return to the Drifter's Camp and talk to Kahl to finish the quest.

fast: Let your brothers hold extra dissipation fields while you stand in one; they cannot die, so send them anywhere.
Use command mode on blocking debris immediately instead of looking for another path.
Kahl regenerates health and has infinite Grakata reserve ammo, so keep pushing instead of waiting for cover.
Pick up the Grattler after the crash for much heavier firepower.

sum: A short side quest on Eris where you track down Mutalist Alad V's lab. It rewards the Mutalist Alad V key blueprint, used to farm Mesa parts.

other: Complete the Pluto to Eris Junction (unlocks Eris)

steps.t: Start Patient Zero from the Codex after the Pluto to Eris Junction.
Run the Spy mission on Naeglar, Eris and collect the Corpus data.
steps.tip: Infested arrive after the second datamass; both factions will attack you.

steps.t: Sabotage the Infested ship on Brugia, Eris (Hive Sabotage).
Sabotage the Infested ship on Saxis, Eris.
Sabotage the Infested ship on Kala-azar, Eris.
On Xini, Eris, destroy the Corpus ship's reactor core, then kill the Infested Mesa before extracting.
steps.tip: Melee finishers can be used on the Infested Mesa for a quick kill.

fast: Bring an Infested-focused loadout (Corrosive/Heat or Gas) for the Hive Sabotage stages.
In Hive Sabotage, a fast Warframe with good area damage clears the hives quickest.
Use a melee finisher on the Infested Mesa to end the fight quickly.
rw: Mutalist Alad V Assassinate Key Blueprint

sum: A short Darvo side quest to rescue his Grineer contractor Clem on Uranus. It awards an Exilus Adapter and unlocks the weekly Help Clem mission.

other: Get the inbox message from Darvo, then talk to Darvo in any Relay and choose "What's the job?"

steps.t: Talk to Darvo in any Relay with "What's the job?" and start the quest from the Codex.
Rescue Clem on Stephano, Uranus before the 2:30 execution timer runs out.
steps.tip: The timer starts on arrival, so rush straight to the cells; don't stand on Clem's pod or you may get stuck.

steps.t: On Caliban, Uranus, pick up Clem's Twin Grakatas in the barracks and kill Vem Tabook.
Survive on Puck, Uranus with Clem until the artifact is found, defeating Shik Tal when he arrives.
Visit Darvo in a Relay to collect your Exilus Adapter.

fast: Use a fast Warframe (e.g. Loki or Volt) to reach Clem's cell before the timer ends.
Stealth Warframes avoid the Grineer reinforcements in the rescue stage.
You do not need Uranus unlocked to play the quest.

sum: A solo side quest about Nef Anyo's bid to lead the Corpus. It rewards the Protea blueprint and the Xoris glaive, and unlocks Armatus on Deimos.

other: Complete the Saturn Junction

steps.t: Start The Deadlock Protocol from the Codex.
Run the Venus Interception (two towers, three rounds) to decrypt Nef Anyo's memo.
Visit Eudico in the Fortuna backroom.
On Venus, find the Protean Sensors and capture then defend the Corpus Systems twice.
Return to Fortuna to learn about the Granum Crown.
On Phobos, kill the Treasurer, grab its Granum Crown and use it on a Granum Tribute.
steps.tip: Survive the Errant Specters until you are ejected.

steps.t: Hack all three vaults in the Europa Spy mission for the Xoris parts, then build the Xoris.
On Neptune, enter the Granum Void, charge the Xoris on Specter Particles and detonate it near each captive.
steps.tip: Three melee kills charge it; detonate mid-flight with Alternate Fire.

steps.t: Fight the Protea Specter and use the Xoris discharge to stop each Temporal Anchor rewind.
steps.tip: You must interrupt her rewind four times in total.

fast: Bring a Spy-friendly stealth frame (Loki, Ivara) for the three Europa vaults.
Keep the Xoris equipped as your melee for the final mission; charge it on Specter Particles before approaching each captive.
Watch for Protea's Temporal Anchor and save a full Xoris charge to cancel it.

sum: A solo Railjack side quest about a ghost ship in Void Storms. It rewards the Sevagoth blueprint and unlocks the Sisters of Parvos.

other: Own a Railjack and have retrieved the Reliquary Key

steps.t: Start the quest from the Codex and read Cephalon Cy's message.
In Veil Proxima (Arc Silver), scavenge the wrecks and fight off Corpus fighters until the ghost ship appears.
In Pluto Proxima (Seven Sirens), hack all three Spy vaults on the Corpus ship.
steps.tip: A Somachord fragment is above one vault; scan it now or you must replay the quest.

steps.t: At Obol Crossing, hold out until Cy re-establishes contact, then board the Tempestarii.
steps.tip: Scan the second Somachord fragment in the forge area.

steps.t: Play as Sevagoth's Shadow and fight off the Corpus waves.
steps.tip: You revive instantly on death, so just keep fighting.

steps.t: Board the Corpus vessel, hack the console, kill the Jamming Drones and the Optio, then destroy the beam generator.
Return to the Tempestarii and repel Corpus fighters until its Ordnance is ready, then finish the final rescue jump.

fast: Bring a Railjack with decent armaments and repair kits; the space fights are the slowest part.
Use a Spy-friendly frame for the three-vault Corpus mission.
If you want the Somachord song, scan both fragments in order the first time.

sum: A side quest for Cephalon Simaris tracking a rogue Warframe. It rewards the Chroma blueprint and unlocks Sanctuary Onslaught and daily Synthesis tasks.

other: Complete the Europa Junction

steps.t: Rescue Simaris' Sentinels on Nuovo, Ceres, then hack the lone data vault.
Talk to Simaris in a Relay; do his Synthesis tutorial first if the dialog option is missing.
steps.tip: He is on the upper level; take the blue lifts or fast travel to him.

steps.t: Buy Synthesis Scanners (5,000 credits) from Simaris and synthesize three Elite Arid Lancers on Mars.
steps.tip: One target spawns per mission; scan all 4 nodes, then complete the mission objective.

steps.t: Report to Simaris and build the Scorched Beacon.
Complete the Mobile Defense on Morax, Europa and build the Chroma Signal.
On Alator, Mars, reach the Arcane Machine and scan the hostile Chroma, then build the Chroma Mark.
steps.tip: Don't kill Chroma; scan it.

steps.t: On Ose, Europa, defend the Arcane Machine for three waves and scan Chroma 5 times.

fast: Equip Kinetic Siphon Traps (5,000 credits from Simaris) to hold Synthesis targets still.
Use Loki's Invisibility or another stealth frame so Synthesis targets don't panic.
Pick short Mars missions (e.g. Exterminate or Capture) for the three Arid Lancer scans.
Bring plenty of Synthesis Scanners for the Chroma stages.

sum: A side quest for Ergo Glast that pits you against Nef Anyo in the Index. It rewards the Nidus blueprint.

other: Speak to Ergo Glast in the Perrin Sequence room of any Relay

steps.t: Talk to Ergo Glast in a Relay and set the quest active.
On Monolith, Phobos, destroy the tumors at each of three gates and protect the Hunters while they close them, then destroy the 6 Spawn Pods.
steps.tip: The mission fails if all 6 Hunters die.

steps.t: Win two Index matches on Neptune (100,000 then 120,000 credit wagers).
steps.tip: Bank several points at once for bonus score; carrying many drains your health.

steps.t: Win the third Index match (140,000 wager).
steps.tip: Your first deposit attempt will kill you; this is scripted.

steps.t: Win the fourth match (160,000 wager) while staying within the 20-point Victory Margin.
steps.tip: Puzzle: if you lead by more than 20 points, Nef backs out and you fail. Win narrowly.

steps.t: Play the fifth match (180,000 wager) and try to deposit points.
steps.tip: You are meant to lose; you must try to deposit or the quest won't progress.

steps.t: Hack at least two vaults in the Spy mission on Oceanum, Pluto.
Win the final Index match (no wager) and choose Neewa's fate in the inbox.
steps.tip: Any choice gives the Nidus blueprint.

fast: Keep at least 180,000 credits on hand: wagers rise from 100,000 to 180,000, you get each back plus profit when you win, but the scripted fifth match costs you its wager.
If you run out of credits, set a different quest active and farm normal Index missions.
In the fourth match, watch the score and stop banking once you are about 15-20 points ahead.
Deposit points in small batches to avoid losing big stacks when you die.

sum: A solo side quest for Cephalon Suda involving the Mandachord and Hydraulus music puzzles. It rewards the Octavia blueprint.

other: Visit Cephalon Suda in a Relay to start it

steps.t: Talk to Cephalon Suda in a Relay to get the Mandachord blueprint.
On Sao, Neptune, follow the white light to collect the Mandachord Body, Fret and Bridge.
Build the Mandachord (3 Morphics, 5,000 credits).
On Stephano, Uranus, find the Hydraulus and complete its song.
steps.tip: Puzzle: as the beat passes each column, set the top-row note to match the height of the glowing blue symbol above it (one of 3 positions). Effects Intensity must be above 0 to see the symbols.

steps.t: On Tycho, Lua, clear the Sentients from the Hydraulus room and solve the second song.
steps.tip: Same idea, but in the second row with 5 positions per column.

steps.t: In the Orokin Tower on Taranis, lock the room, clear it, solve the Hydraulus, then defend both signal amplifiers to 100%.
steps.tip: Kill Sentients near the amplifier to unfreeze the counter.

steps.t: Talk to Simaris in a Relay ("Suda's Datascape?") to enter the datascape.
In the datascape, step on platforms with yellow orbs to reveal notes and remove red errant notes until Hunhow is destroyed over three stages.
steps.tip: Puzzle: don't step on empty dark-brown blocks (they create errant notes); grey blocks are safe. Duck or stand on pillars to dodge the beam.

fast: Bring a frame with good air control (Zephyr, Titania, Wukong) for the datascape platforming.
Use your Operator's Void damage against Sentients to strip their damage adaptation.
Set graphics to Low in the final stage to make errant and correct notes easier to see.
Bring weapons with large ammo reserves; Eradicysts drop nothing.

sum: A side quest bought from Baro Ki'Teer that sends you through an ancient Martian tomb. It rewards all Inaros blueprints.

other: Buy the Sands of Inaros quest blueprint from Baro Ki'Teer (100 Ducats + 25,000 credits) or trade for it
Craft it in the Foundry (Keys tab): 5,000 Nano Spores, 400 Oxium, 1 Nitain Extract

steps.t: Craft the quest key and read Baro's inbox message.
Explore the tomb on Mars and take the Sacred Vessel from the shrine.
Kill 60 of the enemy shown on the vessel (Detron Crewman, Seeker or Volatile Runner).
steps.tip: The quest must be active for kills to count; check the vessel next to the Codex table.

steps.t: Return the vessel to the tomb door in Ara, Mars and take the next vessel, then fight off the Feral Kavats.
Kill 20 of the next enemy (Railgun MOA, Hyekka Master or Brood Mother), return the vessel and beat the splitting Tomb Guardian.
Kill 5 of the last enemy (Bursa, Manic or Juggernaut), return the vessel and defeat the Tomb Protector.
steps.tip: The final fight has about a 15-minute limit.

fast: Kills still count if you abort the mission, so leave as soon as you hit the count.
For Juggernauts, Deimos Juggernauts in Cambion Drift or the Jordas Golem node work; for Manics, Tyl Regor on Uranus spawns Drekar Manics.
For Bursas, fail a Robotic Onslaught conduit in Corpus Disruption (Laomedeia, Neptune).
Equip a weak primary before the Tomb Protector fight; its Sand Shadow copies your primary.
Use area-damage weapons like Penta or Tonkor on the splitting Tomb Guardians.

sum: A riddle side quest where Ordis' poems point you to three missions. It rewards all Mirage component blueprints.

other: Complete the Eris to Sedna Junction

steps.t: Start Hidden Messages from the Codex and read Ordis' first riddle.
Solve riddle one and complete the mission it points to for the Mirage Neuroptics blueprint.
steps.tip: Hint: the home of ancient Greek gods, and a mountain that is also on Mars (answer: Olympus, Mars).

steps.t: Solve riddle two and complete the mission for the Mirage Systems blueprint.
steps.tip: Hint: the nymph from the Odyssey who kept Odysseus on her island, a Saturn node (answer: Calypso, Saturn - Survival).

steps.t: Solve riddle three and complete the mission for the Mirage Chassis blueprint.
steps.tip: Hint: the sea monster that became a whirlpool, a Sedna node (answer: Charybdis, Sedna - Hive Sabotage).

steps.t: Buy the main Mirage blueprint from the Market to build her.

fast: The riddles also appear in the Tenno Guide if you deleted the inbox messages.
You only need to earn each blueprint to progress, not craft it.
Bring an Infested-ready loadout; all three missions are Infested.
Calypso is a 15-minute Survival, so bring a frame that handles crowds, e.g. Saryn or Khora.

sum: A side quest on the Plains of Eidolon at night, following visions from a mask bought from Nakak. It rewards the Revenant blueprint.

other: Reach Observer rank with The Quills
Talk to Nakak in Cetus ("Mask?") and buy the Mask of the Lost One for 1 Cetus Wisp

steps.t: Buy the Mask of the Lost One from Nakak and equip it on your Operator.
steps.tip: Use the Operator, not the Drifter, with the hood closed.

steps.t: At night, go to the southwest side of Gara Toht Lake and interact with the small energy blotch.
Do Cetus Bounties until you get and build any Revenant part.
At night, interact with the blotch on the northeast side of Gara Toht Lake.
Build a second Revenant part from Bounties.
At night, interact with the last blotch on the river between Gara Toht Lake and Renthi Spring, then defeat the Revenant Specter.

fast: Set the quest active before buying Revenant from the Market if you want to skip farming parts.
Forced finishers (Excalibur's Radial Blind, Ash's Teleport) instantly defeat the Revenant Specter.
Atlas's Petrify or Mesa's Peacemaker also shred the Specter.
Check the Cetus day/night timer before heading out; the blotches only appear at night.

sum: A New Loka side quest where you craft Apothics from Earth's plants and anoint a hidden shrine. It rewards all Titania blueprints.

other: Ask Amaryn of New Loka about "The Silver Grove" in a Relay

steps.t: Talk to Amaryn in a Relay and activate the quest from the Codex.
Gather plants and craft the Nightfall Apothic (2 Dusklight Sarracenia, 6 Moonlight Dragonlily, 12 Sunlight Threshcone, 2 Morphics).
steps.tip: Dragonlilies only spawn on Earth forest at night; Threshcones only by day. Sarracenia is in Ceres shipyard swamps.

steps.t: Equip it, go to E Prime, Earth, find the shrine, anoint the altar and kill the Loki Specter.
Craft the Twilight Apothic (2 Moonlight Jadeleaf, 6 Ruk's Claw, 6 Lunar Pitcher, 2 Morphics) and repeat at the shrine.
steps.tip: Jadeleaf is rare, Earth night only; Ruk's Claw on Mars walls; Lunar Pitcher in Lua vases.

steps.t: Craft the Sunrise Apothic (2 Sunlight Jadeleaf, 8 Frostleaf, 12 Vestan Moss, 2 Morphics).
steps.tip: Frostleaf grows on Corpus Outpost cliffs (may need a restart); Vestan Moss on Grineer Asteroid rocks.

steps.t: Anoint the shrine again, defeat the Oberon Specter and defend the shrine for 2 minutes.

fast: Run Capture missions so you can explore freely: Mantle (Earth), Pallas (Ceres), Ara (Mars), Copernicus (Lua), Venera (Venus), Elion (Mercury).
A Resource Booster doubles plants picked up, and Oxylus with Botanist loots plants for you.
Check the Cetus day/night timer to plan Earth day and night plant runs.
Don't use an Apothic outside the quest mission; it is consumed without progressing.

sum: A solo Ventkids side quest where K-Drive feats unlock the pages of a comic. It rewards the Yareli blueprint and Orbiter decorations.

other: Finish Vox Solaris (Quest)

steps.t: Read Roky's inbox message and visit Roky and Boon in Fortuna.
Page 1: do 5 Copters, finish a K-Drive Race, and kill 5 enemies with a secondary while on a K-Drive.
Page 2: do 5 Nose or Tail Plankers, get 5 seconds of air-time, and 5 secondary headshot kills on a K-Drive.
Page 3: keep a trick chain going for 10 seconds, plus 5 Frontside and 5 Backside Rollouts.
Page 4: do two x10 combos, finish 2 different K-Drive Races, and get 5 K-Drive slam kills.
Page 5: kill 5 enemies with a secondary while airborne, collect 10,000 race points, and earn 500 points in one trick chain.
Return to the Ventkids in Fortuna to finish.

fast: Get air-time by flying high with Archwing in the Orb Vallis and then switching to the K-Drive.
Grind the long pipe behind Fortuna's entrance back and forth for long trick chains and big combos.
Equip Inertia Dampeners on your K-Drive to help score points.
Check your current feats in the pause menu.

sum: A side quest where Ordis pieces together a mysterious theorem. It rewards the Limbo component blueprints; buy the main blueprint from the Market.

other: Complete the Jupiter to Europa Junction
Own an Archwing

steps.t: Start the quest from the Codex and read Ordis' message with the Limbo Neuroptics Theorem blueprint.
Run the Archwing Interception on Syrtis, Mars and collect Proof Fragments from killed enemies.
steps.tip: Each Theorem needs 1 Proof Fragment, 3 for the whole quest. The game won't tell you when you have enough; check the Foundry.

steps.t: Craft the Limbo Neuroptics Theorem.
Complete the Excavation on Cambria, Earth (300 Cryotic) for the Limbo Neuroptics blueprint.
Gather another Proof Fragment on Syrtis and craft the Limbo Systems Theorem, then excavate Martialis, Mars.
Craft the Limbo Chassis Theorem and excavate Ose, Europa to finish.

fast: Collect all 3 Proof Fragments in one Syrtis run so you never have to go back.
Theorem crafting takes 10 seconds, so craft immediately after each run.
You only need to earn the blueprints to progress, not build them.
Bring a frame that defends extractors well for the three Excavations.
was: Older guides say each Theorem needs 3 Proof Fragments (9 in total). Update 34 cut it to 1 per Theorem, so the whole quest needs 3.

sum: A side quest to help the stranded Cephalon Jordas against the Infestation. It rewards the Atlas blueprint and unlocks the Jordas Golem Assassination.

other: Complete the Pluto to Eris Junction
Be able to use an Archwing for the final mission

steps.t: Start The Jordas Precept from the Codex.
Kill Infested Juggernauts to collect the Pherliac Pods blueprint and its four parts.
Craft the Pherliac Pods in the Foundry.
Equip the Pods and use one in the Exterminate on Isos, Eris.
Craft the Potent Pherliac Pod (Pherliac Pods + 3 Argon Crystals).
steps.tip: You only have to craft it, not use it.

steps.t: Defeat the Juggernaut Behemoth and then the Jordas Golem in Archwing on Eris.
steps.tip: Shoot the Golem's engines on its back.

fast: Farm Pod parts from Demolisher Juggernauts on Ur, Uranus (Disruption) or Deimos Juggernauts in Cambion Drift; they can spawn multiple times per mission.
Hit a Juggernaut's glowing belly or back maw while it attacks.
Argon Crystals decay daily, so farm them right before crafting the Potent Pod.

sum: The Helminth is an Infested being in your Orbiter's Helminth Infirmary. Once you install the Helminth Segment you can sacrifice (subsume) Warframes to learn one of their abilities and infuse that ability onto other Warframes.

other: Reach Rank 3 - Associate with the Entrati on Deimos
Spend 15,000 Entrati standing on the Helminth Segment blueprint from Son

steps.t: Finish the Heart of Deimos quest to open the Necralisk and the Entrati family on Deimos.
steps.tip: You need Heart of Deimos done to fully access the Entrati syndicate.

steps.t: Reach Mastery Rank 8.
Raise your Entrati standing to Rank 3 - Associate by earning family tokens and trading them to Grandmother for standing.
steps.tip: Each rank-up asks for a pair of family tokens as well as the standing.

steps.t: Buy the Helminth Segment blueprint from Son in the Necralisk for 15,000 standing.
steps.tip: Or skip the grind: the Helminth Segments Bundle in the Market (300 platinum) gives the segment already built.

steps.t: Build the segment in the Foundry: 50,000 credits, 5 Purple Velocipod Tags, 20 Adramal Alloy, 5 Saturated Muscle Mass and 15 Ganglion. It takes 24 hours.
steps.tip: You can rush the build for 50 platinum.

steps.t: Go to the Helminth Infirmary on your Orbiter and sit in the chair to install the segment, then name your Helminth.
steps.tip: After this the room stays open for every Warframe and you can Fast Travel to it.

steps.t: Feed the Helminth resources to fill its Secretions (Bile, Biotics, Calx, Oxides, Pheromones and Synthetics).
steps.tip: A green arrow means it wants that resource (up to 30% conversion) and a red arrow means it's sick of it (as low as 3%). Anything over 100% is wasted.

steps.t: Feed it, subsume and infuse to raise its Metamorphosis rank. Rank 1 (2,250 experience) unlocks Warframe subsuming.
Subsume a Warframe: equip the one you want to give up, sit in the chair, choose Subsume Warframe and type CONFIRM. It finishes after 23 hours.
steps.tip: Only built non-Prime, non-Umbra Warframes can be subsumed, and the Warframe is gone for good. It doesn't need to be max rank. You can rush the 23 hours for 50 platinum.

steps.t: Infuse an ability: sit in the chair with the Warframe you want to change, pick a subsumed ability, choose which ability it replaces and which mod configs get it.
steps.tip: You get one replaced ability per config. You can remove it later, but the Secretions you spent don't come back.

steps.t: Optional: buy the Helminth Invigoration Segment blueprint from Son (30,000 standing, Rank 5 - Family) to give 3 random Warframes a week-long buff each week.

fast: Run Mother's Tier 5 bounties in the Cambion Drift. Two or three runs give enough Mother Tokens to hit the daily standing cap.
Trade spare family tokens to Grandmother for Grandmother Tokens first. Those give 50% more standing than the original tokens would.
Lucent Teroglobe, Pustulite and Ganglion always give double Secretions when fed.

Subsume Warframes you've already mastered instead of selling them. Infusing and removing an ability with an even Secretion cost (like Nyx's Mind Control) over and over is a quick way to raise Metamorphosis rank.
The Helminth Segments Bundle (300 platinum) skips both the standing grind and the build.

sum: The Railjack is a crewable Orokin spacecraft for Empyrean space combat. You build your own during the Rising Tide quest, and you need it for things like Kuva Lich and Sister final fights.

other: Build the Railjack Cephalon from a 35,000-credit Market blueprint to start Rising Tide
Access to a Dry Dock on a Saturn or Pluto Relay, or in a Clan Dojo

steps.t: Finish The War Within.
Buy the Railjack Cephalon blueprint from the Market for 35,000 credits and build it: 5,000 credits, 15 Mutagen Samples, 15 Detonite Ampules and 15 Fieldron Samples. It takes 1 minute.
steps.tip: Building it starts the Rising Tide quest.

steps.t: Go to a Dry Dock on the Saturn (Kronia) or Pluto (Orcus) Relay, or in your Clan Dojo.
Follow Cephalon Cy's leads to find each Railjack section, then repair it at the Dry Dock. Do this for all six sections.
steps.tip: You can donate repair resources a bit at a time. Each repair takes 1 minute and can't be rushed.

steps.t: Board your finished Railjack from the bottom deck of your Orbiter.
Use the Reliquary Drive and do the short mission on Lua to get the Void Key that powers the ship.
Fly Empyrean missions to upgrade components, armaments and Intrinsics.

fast: The Starter Railjack Bundle (175 platinum) gives a built Railjack and marks Rising Tide as complete.
Repairs take at least 6 minutes in total, so farm the resources first and then do all six repairs in one go.
You can join other players' Empyrean missions before you own a Railjack, using the button at the top right of the Navigation screen.
Stronger Sigma parts come from Clan Dojo research. Parts from the other Houses drop as wreckage in missions.

sum: Archwings are flight rigs for combat in space, underwater and in the open worlds. You get your first one, the Odonata, from The Archwing quest.

other: Clear the Mars Junction to unlock The Archwing quest

steps.t: Clear the Mars Junction to unlock The Archwing quest.
Play through The Archwing quest and build the Odonata's Wings, Harness and Systems as the quest asks.
Finish the quest to get the Odonata plus the Imperator archgun and Veritux archmelee.
steps.tip: Finishing the quest also gives you the Plexus for Railjack.

steps.t: Pick your Archwing and its weapons in the Arsenal's vehicle section (Select Mode).
Play Archwing missions in Free Space or Corpus Ship tilesets, or Archwing sections on Uranus.
Research the Amesha, Elytron and Itzal in your Clan Dojo's Tenno Lab to get more Archwings.

fast: Most Archwing weapon parts are offered by the six core Syndicates at Rank 2-3 for 20,000 standing.
In open worlds you can deploy your Archwing for fast travel, but you use your normal primary and secondary weapons there.
Finishing The Archwing quest is required before you can get any other Archwing.

sum: The Operator is the Tenno who controls your Warframes. Once unlocked they can leave the Warframe and fight with Void powers, Amps and Focus abilities.

steps.t: Finish the main quests up to The Second Dream. You get a limited form of control over the Operator (Transcendence) at the end.
Finish The War Within to unlock full Transference, so the Operator can fight on their own.
Customize your Operator at the Somatic Link in the Orbiter's Transference Room.
Visit The Quills in Cetus and Vox Solaris in Fortuna to get Amps and Operator Arcanes.
Choose and level a Focus school to power up your Operator and Warframe.

fast: You can also open Operator options from Settings or the Fast Travel wheel (default Q) without going to the Transference Room.
The Operator counts as a separate body from your Warframe for pressure plates, which helps on puzzles that need two plates held at once.

sum: Focus is the Operator's skill tree, split into five schools that give passive and active powers to the Operator and Warframe. You spend Focus Points on Ways in each tree.

other: Visit The Quills in Cetus to unlock the rest of each tree

steps.t: Finish The Second Dream and pick your first school. You start with that school's two passive Ways.
Finish The War Within to unlock Transference, which lets Focus passives work from the start of every mission.
Finish Saya's Vigil, then visit The Quills in Cetus to reveal and unlock the rest of each Focus tree.
Put a Focus Lens on your gear so that Affinity you earn also turns into Focus Points.
Spend Focus Points on Ways in your school's tree and confirm your choices.
steps.tip: Focus can't be refunded once you confirm.

steps.t: Unlock the other schools for 50,000 Focus Points each.
After The Old Peace, buy a school's Tektolyst Artifact from Marie to unlock its Tauron Strike.

fast: Grab Convergence Orbs when they appear: they give 5,000 Focus right away and multiply Affinity-to-Focus by 10x for 45 seconds.
Eidolon Shards turn into Focus and don't count toward the daily cap (Brilliant: 25,000; Radiant: 40,000).
In Zariman missions, killing dormant Void Angels gives 15,000 Focus and Thrax Centurions/Legatus give 2,500 to the whole squad.
The daily Focus cap is 250,000 plus 5,000 per Mastery Rank and resets at 00:00 UTC.

sum: Kuva Liches are personal Grineer nemeses that you create by Mercy-killing a Kuva Larvling. You beat one by finding the right sequence of Requiem Mods, and you get its Kuva weapon or turn it into an ally.

other: Own a Railjack
Have one Railjack Intrinsic at rank 5 to reach the final fight on the Saturn Proxima

steps.t: Finish The War Within, reach Mastery Rank 5 and get a Railjack.
Play a regular Grineer mission of level 20 or higher. When the lights flicker yellow, kill 15 enemies in about 30 seconds to make a Kuva Larvling appear.
steps.tip: Sorties, Void Fissures, Invasions, quests and Dark Sectors don't count. Steel Path does.

steps.t: Down the Larvling, check which Kuva weapon it shows, then Mercy it with your Parazon to create your Lich.
steps.tip: The Warframe you use sets the Lich's element. If you don't like the weapon, ignore the Larvling and find another.

steps.t: Clear missions on the nodes your Lich controls and Mercy its Thralls to fill Requiem Murmurs, which reveal which Requiem Mods you need.
Get Requiem Mods by opening Requiem Eterna relics in Requiem Fissures on the Kuva Fortress.
steps.tip: Kuva Siphon and Kuva Flood missions drop the relics, and Thralls have a 5% chance.

steps.t: When the Lich shows up, take down its health and stab it with your Parazon to test your Requiem order. If you get it wrong, change the order and try again.
Once the sequence is right, beat the Lich in its Railjack Skirmish on the Saturn Proxima.
Choose Vanquish to get its weapon (ready to claim in the Foundry) or Convert to make it an ally.

fast: Don't stab the Lich until Murmurs have revealed your first Requiem. Then fill the other slots by trial and error so you need fewer attempts.
The Oull mod can stand in for any Requiem Mod, and a beaten Lich has a 25% chance to drop it.
While a Lich is in your mission it turns nearby enemies into Thralls, so you can farm Murmurs from them.
Hold off until you have a decent arsenal. Liches can show up before you know all three Requiems.

sum: Sisters of Parvos are the Corpus version of Kuva Liches. You create one by Mercy-killing a Candidate, then beat her with the right Requiem sequence to get her Tenet weapon and her Hound companion.

other: Have one Railjack Intrinsic at rank 3 to reach the final fight on the Neptune Proxima
Have no other active Lich, Sister or Technocyte Coda

steps.t: Finish The War Within and Call of the Tempestarii, and reach Mastery Rank 5.
In a Corpus Ship mission of level 10 or higher, use a Zenith Granum Crown and clear the Granum Void with at least Rank 1 Nightmare rewards.
steps.tip: Don't finish the Granum Void too close to extraction (roughly 150-200 m), or no Candidate will spawn.

steps.t: Down the Candidate that appears and Mercy it with your Parazon to create your Sister. The Warframe you use sets her element.
Clear her influenced nodes and Mercy her Hounds to reveal her Requiem Mods through Murmurs.
Get Requiem Mods from Requiem Eterna relics, opened in Requiem Fissures on the Kuva Fortress.
When she invades, beat her and stab her with your Requiem sequence. Adjust the order until it's right.
Finish her in the Railjack confrontation on the Neptune Proxima, then Vanquish or Convert her.

fast: Mercy her Hounds to raise her Rage quickly so she invades more often.
When she invades, disable and Mercy her Hound before her first health bar is gone, or she makes it self-destruct.
Hounds have a 5% chance to drop Requiem Eterna relics.

sum: The Steel Path is Teshin's harder version of the Star Chart, with enemies 100 levels higher and doubled resource and mod drop chances. It rewards Steel Essence and extra Mastery.

other: Complete every Star Chart node available before The New War, except the Mutalist Alad V, Jordas Golem and Brutus assassinations
Includes quest-locked nodes such as Tyana Pass, Follie's Hunt, Ropalolyst, Saya's Visions, and all of Lua and the Kuva Fortress

steps.t: Finish the main quests up to Chimera Prologue so every quest-locked node is open.
Talk to Teshin on any Relay and choose "Steel Path?" to see which nodes, quests or Mastery Rank you still need.
steps.tip: You need Mastery Rank 5 for Vay Hek's node on Earth.

steps.t: Clear every remaining node on the list.
Talk to Teshin again and accept the Steel Path. A Steel Path toggle then shows on the right side of the Star Chart.
Clear Steel Path nodes again starting from E Prime on Earth.
Do the 6 daily Steel Path Incursions for 5 Steel Essence each and spend it in Teshin's shop.

fast: Teshin's "Steel Path?" list shows exactly which nodes you're missing, so you don't have to search for them.
Finishing an Incursion unlocks its node, even if you haven't reached it on the Steel Path Star Chart yet.
For open-world nodes, enter with the 6th-tier bounty selected and go straight back to town to unlock the nearby nodes.
Harrow's Condemn or Khora's Ensnare can lock Acolytes in place. Both can be subsumed with the Helminth.
rw: Extra Mastery from Steel Path nodes

sum: Necramechs are heavy Entrati war machines that your Operator can pilot in open worlds, Railjack ground sections and other modes. You build your own from damaged parts on Deimos.

other: Have a free Archwing weapon slot for the Mausolon that comes with it

steps.t: Finish Heart of Deimos. Father gives you the Necramech Casing, Engine, Capsule and Weapon Pod blueprints.
Finish The War Within so your Operator can pilot a Necramech.
Get the Damaged Necramech Casing, Engine, Pod and Weapon Pod by buying them from Father or killing enemy Necramechs in Isolation Vault bounties.
Build the four components and then the Necramech in your Foundry.
Make sure you have a free Archwing weapon slot for the Mausolon archgun.
Equip the Necramech Summon gear (you get it automatically) and use it in the Cambion Drift, Plains of Eidolon or Orb Vallis.

fast: Try one out first: inactive Necramechs with a blue aura in the Cambion Drift can be boarded with Transference.
A pre-built Necramech costs 375 platinum in the Market and comes with an Orokin Reactor.
Get Tactical Intrinsic Rank 5 to summon it in the ground sections of Empyrean missions.

sum: K-Drives are hoverboards for getting around open worlds fast. You get a basic one from the Vox Solaris quest and build custom ones with the Ventkids in Fortuna.

steps.t: Talk to Eudico in Fortuna to start the Vox Solaris quest, then finish it.
You get the K-Drive Launcher gear and a basic Bondi K-Drive. Put the launcher on your gear wheel.
Summon the K-Drive in the Orb Vallis, Plains of Eidolon or Cambion Drift.
Do tricks and K-Drive Races to earn Ventkids standing.
steps.tip: 25% of trick Affinity turns into Ventkids standing.

steps.t: Buy a Board, Reactor, Nose and Jet from the Ventkids in their clubhouse (through the vent above Legs' shop) and assemble a custom K-Drive.
steps.tip: Only the Board gives Mastery. Your Bondi disappears once you own a custom K-Drive.

steps.t: Mod your K-Drive in the Arsenal's vehicle section.

fast: Each trick chain is capped at 3,000 Affinity (750 standing). Primo Flair raises that cap to 6,000.
Grab the blue crystals that appear while you ride to boost the standing multiplier for your current chain.
Five K-Drive races in the Orb Vallis refresh daily. Open your map while on the K-Drive to see them.

sum: The Clan Dojo is your clan's home base. It's where you research and copy special gear, trade with other players, and use amenities like the Dry Dock and Obstacle Course.

other: Join or create a Clan
Build a Clan Key

steps.t: Join a clan or create your own from the Clan menu. You get a Clan Key blueprint when you join.
Build the Clan Key: 1,500 credits, 1 Morphics, 500 Polymer Bundle and 500 Ferrite. It takes 12 hours.
steps.tip: You can rush it for 10 platinum.

steps.t: Pick your Dojo on the Star Chart as if it were a planet and enter it.
Use the research labs to replicate gear for credits, trade at Trading Posts or from the menu, and use rooms like the Dry Dock.
Donate resources to the Vault or to room construction to help the clan grow.

fast: Joining an established clan that has already finished its research lets you buy those blueprints right away.
You can trade with non-members in your Dojo by inviting them to your squad.
Playing with clanmates puts bonus resources into the Clan Vault, on top of your own drops.

sum: Relays are Tenno hub stations where you meet other players and find Syndicates, Cephalon Simaris, Darvo, Teshin, Baro Ki'Teer and Ducat kiosks.

other: Unlock a planet that has a Relay

steps.t: Open the Navigation console and pick a planet with a Relay, such as Mercury (Larunda), Earth (Strata), Mars (Maroo's Bazaar), Saturn (Kronia) or Pluto (Orcus).
Select the Relay node and enter it like a mission.
Visit the Syndicate rooms in the side wings. Syndicate rewards need Mastery Rank 3.
Go up to the second floor of the North Wing to find Darvo's Market and Cephalon Simaris's Sanctuary.
Trade Prime parts for Ducats at the kiosks and check when Baro Ki'Teer arrives next.

fast: Maroo's Bazaar on Mars has Maroo's weekly Ayatan mission and Varzia's Prime Resurgence shop.
Dry Docks for your Railjack are on the Saturn and Pluto Relays.
At Mastery Rank 30 you can use the True Master's Font to give everyone in the Relay a 3-hour 25% boost.

sum: Nightwave is Nora Night's battle-pass-style syndicate. You complete daily and weekly Acts for standing, rank up for rewards, and spend Creds in her shop.

steps.t: Finish The Teacher quest.
Open Nightwave from the Navigation console, the banner at the lower right of the main menu, or the Radio Scanner in your Orbiter.
Complete Acts: Dailies give 1,000 standing, Weeklies 4,500 and Elite Weeklies 7,000.
Rank up every 10,000 standing (30 ranks per Series) and claim each rank's reward.
Spend the Nightwave Creds you earn in Cred Offerings, which refresh weekly.

fast: Daily Acts last 3 days, so you can do several in one session.
Missed weekly Acts come back later as Recovered Acts, three at a time.
Elite Weeklies give the most standing per Act, so do them first when you can.
Past rank 30, each prestige rank gives 15 Creds.

sum: Void Relics are cracked open in Void Fissure missions to get Prime parts and Forma blueprints. Refining them with Void Traces improves your odds at rare rewards.

other: Get your first relic for Void Fissures to appear
Clear the Mars Junction (on Earth) and install the Void Relic Segment to refine relics

steps.t: Earn relics from missions, mostly endless missions. Any mission in the Void guarantees one.
Clear the Mars Junction on Earth and install the Void Relic Segment it gives you in your Orbiter.
Pick a Void Fissure mission whose tier (Lith, Meso, Neo or Axi) matches your relic, and equip the relic.
Collect 10 Reactant during the mission to crack the relic.
Finish the mission and choose one reward from your squad's opened relics.
Spend Void Traces at the Relic Segment to refine relics: Exceptional (25), Flawless (50) or Radiant (100).

fast: Four players with Radiant relics have the best chance at rare parts, since each player can pick from everyone's rewards.
Endless Fissures give pre-refined relics every fifth rotation, such as Radiant at 75 minutes of Survival.
Syndicates, Suumbaat, Smokefinger and Otak sell 3-relic packs for 20,000 standing. Teshin sells them for 15 Steel Essence.
Relics can be traded, which helps with vaulted ones.

sum: Riven Mods are random, weapon-specific mods with two or three bonuses and sometimes a downside. You unveil one by finishing its challenge and can reroll its stats with Kuva.

other: Each unveiled Riven needs Mastery Rank 8 to 16 to equip, depending on the mod

steps.t: Finish The War Within to get your first veiled Riven Mod.
Equip the veiled Riven on gear of the matching type to see its challenge.
Complete the challenge with the Riven equipped somewhere in your loadout.
steps.tip: Any weapon or ability can finish the challenge. The weapon you use has no effect on the result.

steps.t: Check the unveiled Riven's weapon, stats, polarity and Mastery Rank requirement, then rank it up with Endo.
Reroll (Cycle) its stats with Kuva if you want better rolls.
Get more Rivens from Palladino in Iron Wake (10 Riven Slivers, twice per week, needs Chains of Harrow), Sorties, Acrithis (15 Pathos Clamps) and Steel Path sources.

fast: Unveil several at once by putting a veiled Riven on each eligible piece of gear, especially if they share a challenge.
Sorties give Melee Rivens most often (about 8%).
Rivens you don't need can be traded to other players or dissolved into Endo.

sum: Incarnon is a weapon upgrade system that adds evolution perks and an Incarnon Form. Many standard weapons can get it by installing an Incarnon Genesis earned from the Steel Path Circuit.

other: Unlock The Steel Path
Own the weapon the Genesis is for

steps.t: Finish The Duviri Paradox and unlock The Steel Path.
Run The Circuit with the Steel Path toggle on and earn up to two Incarnon Geneses per week from its reward track.
steps.tip: The weapons on offer change every week.

steps.t: Bring the Genesis, the matching weapon and the Duviri resources needed to Cavalero in the Chrysalith on the Zariman to install it.
Complete evolution challenges to unlock perks: Evolution II is a solo mission with the weapon, and Evolution III is 100 kills in Incarnon Form (or 6 Incarnon activations in one mission for melee).
For native Incarnon weapons, finish Angels of the Zariman (Cavalero blueprints, MR 14) or Whispers in the Walls and The Deadlock Protocol (Armatus on Deimos).
